set-variable.value: #[do { var h = attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default '' --- if (h matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/) h else correlationId }]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "T08.start", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" --- (vars.bookingResult.response default {}) ++ (if (isEmpty(vars.addOns default [])) {} else {add_ons: vars.addOns})]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "T08.success", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId, propertyCode: payload.meta.property_code, resolution: payload.meta.resolution, rooms: (payload.rooms default []) map {room: $.room_code, rate: $.rate.rate_plan_code}, totalStayPrice: payload.meta.total_stay_price, currency: payload.meta.currency, addOns: sizeOf(payload.add_ons default []), elapsedMs: (now() as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}) - vars.startedAt}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

raise-error.description: Selected room or rate not available

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn="everywhere" var r = vars.bookingRequest default {} var meta = vars.bookingResult.response.meta default {} var rooms = vars.bookingResult.response.rooms default [] --- { messageId: vars.traceId, memberId: "", language: r.language, currencyCode: meta.currency, propertyCode: r.propertyCode, checkinDate: meta.checkin_date, checkoutDate: meta.checkout_date, noOfAdults: (meta.noOfadults default 1) as String, noOfChildren: (meta.noOfchildren default 0) as String, ratePlanCodes: (rooms map $.rate.rate_plan_code) distinctBy $, channel: "mobile", promoCorpCode: "", voucherCode: r.voucherCode }

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.addons.request", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId, body: vars.addOnRequest}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.addons.response", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId, status: attributes.statusCode, topLevel: if (payload is Object) (keysOf(payload) map ($ as String)) else typeOf(payload) as String, firstEntry: do { var arrays = if (payload is Array) [payload] else if (payload is Object) ((payload pluck $) filter ($ is Array)) else [] --- if (isEmpty(arrays) or isEmpty(arrays[0])) null else if (arrays[0][0] is Object) (keysOf(arrays[0][0]) map ($ as String)) else typeOf(arrays[0][0]) as String }}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.addons.unavailable", tool: vars.toolName, correlationId: vars.traceId, status: error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default null, errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier, detail: error.description}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-variable.value: #[{category: 'FUNCTIONAL', code: 'BAD_REQUEST', message: vars.errorMessage default 'Invalid request.', retryable: false}]
#[{category: 'FUNCTIONAL', code: vars.errorCode default 'RATE_NOT_AVAILABLE', message: vars.errorMessage default 'The selected room or rate is no longer available.', retryable: false}]
#[{category: 'FUNCTIONAL', code: vars.errorCode default 'PROPERTY_NOT_FOUND', message: vars.errorMessage default 'Property not found.', retryable: false}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'DOWNSTREAM_TIMEOUT', message: 'Room and rate service timed out. Retry later.', retryable: true}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'DOWNSTREAM_REJECTED', message: 'Room and rate service rejected the request. Contact support with the correlation ID.', retryable: false}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'DOWNSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Room and rate service unavailable. Contact support with the correlation ID.', retryable: true}]
#[{category: 'TECHNICAL', code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'Request failed. Contact support with the correlation ID.', retryable: false}]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.downstream.error", tool: vars.toolName default "create_booking", correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, propertyCode: vars.bookingRequest.propertyCode default null, status: error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default null, errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier, detail: error.description, body: do { var b = (if (error.errorMessage.payload is String) error.errorMessage.payload else write(error.errorMessage.payload default "", "application/json", {indent: false})) as String --- if (sizeOf(b) > 1000) b[0 to 999] else b }}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.downstream.error", tool: vars.toolName default "create_booking", correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, note: "downstream body is not readable"}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[output text/plain --- write({event: "xapi.failure", tool: vars.toolName default "create_booking", correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, status: vars.httpStatus, category: vars.publicError.category, code: vars.publicError.code, errorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier, detail: error.description}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- {success: false, correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, error: vars.publicError}]
